description:
Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plots illustrate the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy, with error bars representing variability. Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Initial Confidence" with a linear scale ranging from 0.81 to 0.99, with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The first plot displays three lines. A light blue line, marked with circle symbols, begins at approximately 0.82 with a value of 0.86 and ends at 0.99 with a value of 0.91. This line generally fluctuates between 0.84 and 0.92 throughout the x-axis range. An orange dashed line, marked with triangle symbols, starts at 0.82 with a value of 0.31 and decreases to a value of 0.08 at 0.99. A dark green dashed line, marked with square symbols, begins at 0.82 with a value of 0.53 and increases to a value of 0.89 at 0.99.
